data.fluent.conf:
<system>
  log_level warn
</system>
<source>
  @type tail
  @id clinic_container_logs
  path /var/log/pods/staging_*/*/*.log,/var/log/pods/production_*/*/*.log
  pos_file /buffers/clinic-tail.pos
  tag clinic.logs
  read_from_head true
  path_key source_path
  <parse>
    @type regexp
    expression /^(?<cri_time>[^ ]+) (?<stream>stdout|stderr) (?<flag>[FP]) (?<log>.*)$/
  </parse>
</source>
<filter clinic.logs>
  @type parser
  key_name log
  reserve_data true
  remove_key_name_field true
  emit_invalid_record_to_error false
  <parse>
    @type json
    time_key timestamp
    keep_time_key true
  </parse>
</filter>
<filter clinic.logs>
  @type grep
  <regexp>
    key timestamp
    pattern /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}T/
  </regexp>
</filter>
<filter clinic.logs>
  @type record_transformer
  enable_ruby true
  <record>
    namespace ${record['source_path'].split('/')[4].split('_')[0]}
    pod ${record['source_path'].split('/')[4].split('_')[1]}
    container ${record['source_path'].split('/')[5]}
    environment ${record['source_path'].split('/')[4].split('_')[0]}
    service ${record['service'] || record['source_path'].split('/')[5]}
    level ${record['level'] || 'UNKNOWN'}
    message ${record['message'] || record['log'] || 'container_log'}
  </record>
  remove_keys source_path,flag,cri_time
</filter>
<filter clinic.logs>
  @type record_transformer
  remove_keys password,token,authorization,Authorization,email,recipient
</filter>
# A separate branch instruments only structured frontend access logs.
<match clinic.logs>
  @type copy
  <store>
    @type relabel
    @label @ELASTIC
  </store>
  <store>
    @type relabel
    @label @FRONTEND_METRICS
  </store>
</match>
<label @FRONTEND_METRICS>
  <filter clinic.logs>
    @type grep
    <regexp>
      key service
      pattern /^frontend$/
    </regexp>
    <regexp>
      key category
      pattern /^(api|static|health)$/
    </regexp>
  </filter>
  <filter clinic.logs>
    @type prometheus
    <labels>
      namespace $.namespace
      service frontend
      category $.category
    </labels>
    <metric>
      name clinic_frontend_requests_total
      type counter
      desc Structured frontend access requests
      <labels>
        status $.status
      </labels>
    </metric>
    <metric>
      name clinic_frontend_duration_seconds
      type histogram
      desc End to end frontend request duration including API proxy
      key duration
      buckets 0.005,0.025,0.1,0.5,1,2.5,5,10,30
    </metric>
  </filter>
  <match **>
    @type null
  </match>
</label>
<label @ELASTIC>
  <match clinic.logs>
    @type elasticsearch
    host elasticsearch.logging.svc
    port 9200
    scheme https
    ssl_verify true
    ca_file /tls/ca.crt
    user fluentd_writer
    password "#{ENV.fetch('ELASTIC_WRITER_PASSWORD')}"
    logstash_format true
    logstash_prefix clinic-logs
    suppress_type_name true
    verify_es_version_at_startup true
    default_elasticsearch_version 9
    reconnect_on_error true
    reload_connections false
    request_timeout 10s
    <buffer>
      @type file
      path /buffers/elastic
      flush_interval 5s
      chunk_limit_size 2m
      total_limit_size 64m
      retry_type exponential_backoff
      retry_max_interval 30s
      retry_timeout 24h
      overflow_action block
    </buffer>
  </match>
</label>
<source>
  @type prometheus
  bind 0.0.0.0
  port 24231
</source>
<source>
  @type prometheus_output_monitor
  interval 10
</source>

data.datasources.yml:
apiVersion: 1
datasources:
- name: Prometheus
  uid: clinic-prometheus
  type: prometheus
  access: proxy
  url: http://prometheus.monitoring.svc:9090
  isDefault: true
  editable: false

data.providers.yml:
apiVersion: 1
providers:
- name: clinic
  orgId: 1
  folder: An Uyên Hospital
  type: file
  disableDeletion: false
  editable: false
  updateIntervalSeconds: 30
  options:
    path: /var/lib/grafana/dashboards

data.prometheus.yml:
global:
  scrape_interval: 15s
  evaluation_interval: 15s
  external_labels:
    cluster: anuyen-lab
rule_files:
- /etc/prometheus/rules/*.yml
alerting:
  alertmanagers:
  - static_configs:
    - targets:
      - alertmanager.monitoring.svc:9093
scrape_configs:
- job_name: prometheus
  static_configs:
  - targets:
    - localhost:9090
- job_name: clinic
  kubernetes_sd_configs:
  - role: pod
    namespaces:
      names:
      - staging
      - production
  relabel_configs:
  - source_labels:
    - __meta_kubernetes_pod_label_app_kubernetes_io_name
    regex: api|publisher|worker
    action: keep
  - source_labels:
    - __meta_kubernetes_pod_container_port_number
    regex: 8000|8001|8002
    action: keep
  - source_labels:
    - __meta_kubernetes_namespace
    target_label: namespace
  - source_labels:
    - __meta_kubernetes_pod_name
    target_label: pod
  - source_labels:
    - __meta_kubernetes_pod_label_app_kubernetes_io_name
    target_label: service
  metric_relabel_configs:
  - regex: event_id|request_id|correlation_id|email|appointment_id
    action: labeldrop
  honor_labels: true
- job_name: rabbitmq-staging
  metrics_path: /metrics/per-object
  static_configs:
  - targets:
    - rabbitmq.staging.svc:15692
    labels:
      namespace: staging
      service: rabbitmq
- job_name: postgres-staging
  static_configs:
  - targets:
    - postgres-exporter.staging.svc:9187
    labels:
      namespace: staging
      service: postgres
- job_name: rabbitmq-production
  metrics_path: /metrics/per-object
  static_configs:
  - targets:
    - rabbitmq.production.svc:15692
    labels:
      namespace: production
      service: rabbitmq
- job_name: postgres-production
  static_configs:
  - targets:
    - postgres-exporter.production.svc:9187
    labels:
      namespace: production
      service: postgres
- job_name: node
  static_configs:
  - targets:
    - 192.168.150.10:9100
    labels:
      node: anuyen-jenkins
  - targets:
    - 192.168.150.11:9100
    labels:
      node: anuyen-k3s-server
  - targets:
    - 192.168.150.12:9100
    labels:
      node: anuyen-k3s-agent
- job_name: kube-state-metrics
  static_configs:
  - targets:
    - kube-state-metrics.monitoring.svc:8080
- job_name: kubelet
  scheme: https
  authorization:
    credentials_file: /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/token
  tls_config:
    ca_file: /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/ca.crt
  metrics_path: /metrics/cadvisor
  kubernetes_sd_configs:
  - role: node
  relabel_configs:
  - source_labels:
    - __meta_kubernetes_node_address_InternalIP
    regex: (.+)
    target_label: __address__
    replacement: ${1}:10250
  - source_labels:
    - __meta_kubernetes_node_name
    target_label: node
- job_name: fluentd
  kubernetes_sd_configs:
  - role: pod
    namespaces:
      names:
      - logging
  relabel_configs:
  - source_labels:
    - __meta_kubernetes_pod_label_app_kubernetes_io_name
    regex: fluentd
    action: keep
  - source_labels:
    - __meta_kubernetes_pod_container_port_number
    regex: '24231'
    action: keep
  - source_labels:
    - __meta_kubernetes_pod_node_name
    target_label: node
- job_name: alertmanager
  static_configs:
  - targets:
    - alertmanager.monitoring.svc:9093

data.clinic.yml:
groups:
- name: clinic-recording
  rules:
  - record: clinic:service_expected
    expr: vector(1)
    labels:
      namespace: staging
      service: api
  - record: clinic:service_expected
    expr: vector(1)
    labels:
      namespace: staging
      service: publisher
  - record: clinic:service_expected
    expr: vector(1)
    labels:
      namespace: staging
      service: worker
  - record: clinic:backup_expected
    expr: vector(1)
    labels:
      namespace: staging
      service: postgres
  - record: clinic:service_expected
    expr: vector(1)
    labels:
      namespace: production
      service: api
  - record: clinic:service_expected
    expr: vector(1)
    labels:
      namespace: production
      service: publisher
  - record: clinic:service_expected
    expr: vector(1)
    labels:
      namespace: production
      service: worker
  - record: clinic:backup_expected
    expr: vector(1)
    labels:
      namespace: production
      service: postgres
  - record: clinic:api_request_rate5m
    expr: sum by(namespace) (rate(clinic_http_requests_total{route=~"/api/.*"}[5m]))
  - record: clinic:api_error_ratio5m
    expr: sum by(namespace) (rate(clinic_http_requests_total{route=~"/api/.*",status=~"5.."}[5m])) / clamp_min(clinic:api_request_rate5m,
      0.000001)
  - record: clinic:api_p95_seconds5m
    expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by(namespace,le) (rate(clinic_http_duration_seconds_bucket{route=~"/api/.*"}[5m])))
  - record: clinic:container_cpu_cores5m
    expr: sum by(namespace,container) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace=~"staging|production",container!="",container!="POD"}[5m]))
  - record: clinic:container_memory_bytes
    expr: sum by(namespace,container) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace=~"staging|production",container!="",container!="POD"})
- name: clinic-alerts
  rules:
  - alert: ClinicServiceDown
    expr: clinic:service_expected unless on(namespace,service) (max by(namespace,service) (up{job="clinic"}) ==
      1)
    for: 30s
    labels:
      severity: critical
    annotations:
      summary: Không có instance backend được scrape thành công
      description: namespace={{ $labels.namespace }} service={{ $labels.service }} value={{ $value }}
      runbook_url: https://github.com/vxxngw/DevOps/blob/codex/milestone-4/docs/runbooks/alerts.md#service-down
  - alert: ClinicScrapeFailed
    expr: up{job=~"rabbitmq-.*|postgres-.*|node|kubelet|fluentd|kube-state-metrics"} == 0
    for: 1m
    labels:
      severity: warning
      service: monitoring
    annotations:
      summary: Mất nguồn metric
      description: namespace={{ $labels.namespace }} service={{ $labels.service }} value={{ $value }}
      runbook_url: https://github.com/vxxngw/DevOps/blob/codex/milestone-4/docs/runbooks/alerts.md#scrape-failed
  - alert: ClinicHighHttpErrors
    expr: clinic:api_error_ratio5m > 0.05 and on(namespace) clinic:api_request_rate5m > 0.016
    for: 2m
    labels:
      severity: critical
      service: api
    annotations:
      summary: Tỷ lệ lỗi HTTP nghiệp vụ trên 5%
      description: namespace={{ $labels.namespace }} service={{ $labels.service }} value={{ $value }}
      runbook_url: https://github.com/vxxngw/DevOps/blob/codex/milestone-4/docs/runbooks/alerts.md#http-errors
  - alert: ClinicHighHttpLatency
    expr: clinic:api_p95_seconds5m > 1 and on(namespace) clinic:api_request_rate5m > 0.016
    for: 2m
    labels:
      severity: warning
      service: api
    annotations:
      summary: HTTP nghiệp vụ p95 trên 1 giây
      description: namespace={{ $labels.namespace }} service={{ $labels.service }} value={{ $value }}
      runbook_url: https://github.com/vxxngw/DevOps/blob/codex/milestone-4/docs/runbooks/alerts.md#latency
  - alert: ClinicQueueBacklog
    expr: sum by(namespace,vhost,queue) (rabbitmq_queue_messages{queue=~"clinic[.].*[.]notifications"}) > 100
    for: 2m
    labels:
      severity: warning
      service: worker
    annotations:
      summary: Backlog thông báo kéo dài
      description: namespace={{ $labels.namespace }} service={{ $labels.service }} value={{ $value }}
      runbook_url: https://github.com/vxxngw/DevOps/blob/codex/milestone-4/docs/runbooks/alerts.md#queue-backlog
  - alert: ClinicQueueNoConsumer
    expr: (rabbitmq_queue_messages{queue=~"clinic[.].*[.]notifications"} > 0) and on(namespace,vhost,queue) (rabbitmq_queue_consumers
      == 0)
    for: 30s
    labels:
      severity: critical
      service: worker
    annotations:
      summary: Có thông báo nhưng không có consumer
      description: namespace={{ $labels.namespace }} service={{ $labels.service }} value={{ $value }}
      runbook_url: https://github.com/vxxngw/DevOps/blob/codex/milestone-4/docs/runbooks/alerts.md#no-consumer
  - alert: ClinicDlqNotEmpty
    expr: rabbitmq_queue_messages{queue=~"clinic[.].*[.]dlq"} > 0
    for: 30s
    labels:
      severity: critical
      service: worker
    annotations:
      summary: DLQ đang giữ sự kiện thất bại
      description: namespace={{ $labels.namespace }} service={{ $labels.service }} value={{ $value }}
      runbook_url: https://github.com/vxxngw/DevOps/blob/codex/milestone-4/docs/runbooks/alerts.md#dlq
  - alert: ClinicOutboxOld
    expr: clinic_outbox_oldest_seconds > 120 and on(namespace,pod) clinic_outbox_pending > 0
    for: 1m
    labels:
      severity: warning
      service: publisher
    annotations:
      summary: Outbox có sự kiện chờ quá 120 giây
      description: namespace={{ $labels.namespace }} service={{ $labels.service }} value={{ $value }}
      runbook_url: https://github.com/vxxngw/DevOps/blob/codex/milestone-4/docs/runbooks/alerts.md#outbox
  - alert: ClinicHighNodeCpu
    expr: (1 - avg by(node) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle"}[5m]))) > 0.85
    for: 5m
    labels:
      severity: warning
      service: node
    annotations:
      summary: CPU node trên 85%
      description: namespace={{ $labels.namespace }} service={{ $labels.service }} value={{ $value }}
      runbook_url: https://github.com/vxxngw/DevOps/blob/codex/milestone-4/docs/runbooks/alerts.md#cpu
  - alert: ClinicHighNodeMemory
    expr: 1 - node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes / node_memory_MemTotal_bytes > 0.9
    for: 5m
    labels:
      severity: warning
      service: node
    annotations:
      summary: RAM node trên 90%
      description: namespace={{ $labels.namespace }} service={{ $labels.service }} value={{ $value }}
      runbook_url: https://github.com/vxxngw/DevOps/blob/codex/milestone-4/docs/runbooks/alerts.md#memory
  - alert: ClinicBackupStale
    expr: (time() - max by(namespace) (clinic_backup_last_success_timestamp_seconds) > 90000) or (clinic:backup_expected
      unless on(namespace) clinic_backup_last_success_timestamp_seconds)
    for: 5m
    labels:
      severity: critical
      service: postgres
    annotations:
      summary: Backup quá 25 giờ hoặc chưa có metric thành công
      description: namespace={{ $labels.namespace }} service={{ $labels.service }} value={{ $value }}
      runbook_url: https://github.com/vxxngw/DevOps/blob/codex/milestone-4/docs/runbooks/alerts.md#backup
  - alert: ClinicBackupFailed
    expr: clinic_backup_last_run_success == 0
    for: 30s
    labels:
      severity: critical
      service: postgres
    annotations:
      summary: Lần chạy backup gần nhất thất bại
      description: namespace={{ $labels.namespace }} service={{ $labels.service }} value={{ $value }}
      runbook_url: https://github.com/vxxngw/DevOps/blob/codex/milestone-4/docs/runbooks/alerts.md#backup
  - alert: ClinicDatabaseDown
    expr: pg_up == 0
    for: 30s
    labels:
      severity: critical
      service: postgres
    annotations:
      summary: PostgreSQL không trả lời exporter
      description: namespace={{ $labels.namespace }} dependency={{ $labels.dependency }}
      runbook_url: https://github.com/vxxngw/DevOps/blob/codex/milestone-4/docs/runbooks/alerts.md#service-down
  - alert: ClinicDependencyDown
    expr: clinic_dependency_ready == 0
    for: 30s
    labels:
      severity: critical
      service: backend
    annotations:
      summary: Dependency của backend chưa sẵn sàng
      description: namespace={{ $labels.namespace }} dependency={{ $labels.dependency }}
      runbook_url: https://github.com/vxxngw/DevOps/blob/codex/milestone-4/docs/runbooks/alerts.md#service-down
